# Library: real jobs

Each job is a task a person does, with an outcome a check observes, the trap a reviewer hits first,
and where its check runs: **C** the CLI on Linux, **Cm** the CLI headless on macOS, **J** a UI journey.
**baseline** is the hand estimate when the job was added; the live status comes from the nightly run.
The done rule: docs/factory/packets.md (Jobs) and docs/factory/lead.md rule 21.

35 jobs: 18 C, 11 Cm, 6 J. Baseline 4 pass, 1 partial, 30 fail, 0 unknown; baseline score **1.7/10** (10 × Σ weight × credit ÷ Σ weight; pass 1, partial 0.5, else 0).
